questions.question: Kaposi's sarcoma-associated herpesvirus (KSHV/HHV-8) maintains its latent episomal genome inside host nuclei during cell division. Which viral protein tethers the viral episome directly to host mitotic chromosomes?

Lassa virus utilizes an ambisense gene expression strategy on its Small (S) genomic RNA segment. Which statement correctly describes how the Nucleoprotein (NP) and Glycoprotein Precursor (GPC) mRNAs are transcribed?
options: Both NP and GPC mRNAs are transcribed directly from the negative-sense genomic RNA strand.
GPC mRNA is transcribed directly from genomic RNA, whereas NP mRNA is transcribed from antigenomic RNA.
NP mRNA is transcribed directly from genomic RNA, whereas GPC mRNA is transcribed from antigenomic RNA.
NP and GPC are translated as a single polyprotein from genomic RNA and cleaved by host furin.

questions.question: Which cell surface receptor is primarily used by wild-type measles virus to infect immune cells (such as lymphocytes and dendritic cells), causing transient systemic immunosuppression and 'immune amnesia'?
Human noroviruses display tissue tropism and susceptibility patterns determined largely by their specific binding interactions with which host cell molecules on gut mucosal surfaces?

Talimogene laherparepvec (T-VEC) is an FDA-approved oncolytic herpes simplex virus type 1 (HSV-1) therapy. Which neurovirulence gene is functionally deleted from the HSV-1 backbone to prevent viral replication in non-malignant cells while permitting selective lysis of cancer cells with deficient PKR pathways?
